Q907.Description: JSM 1G/2D/3S NMOS in low-current two-permission charger inhibit; not the battery power path.

Q908.Description: JSM 1G/2D/3S NMOS in low-current two-permission charger inhibit; not the battery power path.

R930.Description: nCE pullup to pre-AON REGN; Q907 and Q908 must both conduct to authorize charging.

R931.Description: Series GPIO2 resistor limits manual clamp current. Low permit inhibits frontlight and charging without I2C.

R932.Description: Strong default-low gate bias, using the already reviewed FH10k exact part.

R933.Description: Strong default-low gate bias, using the already reviewed FH10k exact part.

TP19.Description: Copper-only test access. Pull low to inhibit frontlight and charging. R931 limits GPIO contention; never inject voltage.

electrical_intent.charger: REGN/R930 pull nCE high. Q907 and Q908 series sink requires both CHG_REQUEST and direct GPIO2-derived permit. No battery power-path changes.
electrical_intent.frontlight: GPIO2 through R931 drives EN independent of I2C. XL9535 P15 is NC, P16 remains PWM. TP19 may be grounded manually; never inject voltage.
electrical_intent.reset: External 10k || 100k pulldowns keep both gates low when MCU/XL pins are high impedance. Firmware must not retain GPIO2 HIGH through reset/sleep.

static_screens.on_state_note: 2.5V gate RdsON specification is only at its stated conditions. Low-current turn-on, cold/hot leakage and rail-ramp behavior require prototype measurements; no worst-case analog certification from topology alone.
